explication: D2L is an open-source, hands-on deep-learning book: readers study explanations, mathematics, figures, and runnable examples, with framework-specific helper code supporting the examples. Its content ranges from foundations and model training through specialized applications, with mathematics and tooling appendices. The four backend modules provide parallel PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and MXNet APIs. The README documents the integrated book-and-code experience; backend imports and framework dependencies are visible in the excerpts. Most chapter implementations and their specific code links were not sampled, so those relationships are not expanded.
